svg.title: Amplatzer Piccolo Occluder - orthographic oblique - original illustrative schematic
svg.desc: Piccolo 9-PDAP-04-02-L | 4 mm waist / 2 mm length / 5.25 mm discs. Distal +Z: disc opposite microscrew; delivery may be antegrade or retrograde. Fixed orthographic projection.
